COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
30.04.2025
C528 No.550 of 2025
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, A.G.A. for the State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner/accused would 
submit that this is the petition for quashing of charge￾sheet and the cognizance order dated 27.08.2022 as well 
as the entire proceedings emanating therefrom.
4. He would further submit that the 
petitioner/accused was in relationship with the 
respondent no.2/complainant and the allegations against 
the petitioner/accused is that he established physical 
relations with respondent no.2/complainant under the 
false promise of marriage notwithstanding the fact that 
the petitioner/accused was already married, the fact 
which came in the knowledge of the respondent 
no.2/complainant, as alleged, after he established 
physical relations. 
5. He would further submit that in the statement 
recorded under Section 161 of the Cr.P.C., respondent 
no. 2/complainant merely alleged that the 
petitioner/accused attempted to establish physical 
relations with her; that, it was only for the first time in 
her statement recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. 
where she alleged that the petitioner/accused had 
established physical relations with her on the pretext of 
marriage.
6. Issue notice to respondent no.2 through ordinary 
and registered post acknowledgement due as well as via 
WhatsApp and Email, if available.
7. Steps to be taken within two weeks.
8. Counter affidavit may be filed by the respondents 
by the next date of listing. 9. List on 04.07.2025.
10. Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of 
Sessions Trial No.31 of 2023 under Sections 376 and 
506 of IPC, pending in the court of Ist Additional 
Sessions Judge, Rishikesh, Dehradun, shall remain 
stayed.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 
 30.04.2025
Rajni
